FROM superhero.superhero s
JOIN superhero.colour ec ON s.eye_colour_id = ec.id
JOIN superhero.colour hc ON s.hair_colour_id = hc.id
WHERE ec.colour = 'Blue' AND hc.colour = 'Blond'
